allow-break.ly.notes: no allowBreak/noBreak-permission grammar in Lily# (break = forced only)

auto-beam-bar.ly.claim: automatic beams do not cross bar lines
auto-beam-bar.ly.notes: pickup [3], then [8 8][8 16 16][16x4] — matches LP. partial 8*3 spelled as partial 4. (no multiplier grammar); mid-measure \section bar dropped (no mid-measure barline in Lily#); pitches made explicit (c)

auto-beam-breathe.ly.notes: no breathe mark in Lily# grammar (HANDOFF 98-5c: SplitAttachments has no seat either)

auto-beam-ossia.ly.claim: beamable note does not extend a staff symbol
auto-beam-ossia.ly.notes: partial-width staff symbol (issue 5499 regime) has no Lily# counterpart — staves span the system

auto-beam-partial-grace.ly.claim: grace at partial start does not break autobeaming
auto-beam-partial-grace.ly.notes: grace flagged, d8 d8 pair, 4+4 in the full bar — matches LP visually (same-paper crop)

auto-beam-partial.ly.claim: autobeam works properly in partial measures
auto-beam-partial.ly.notes: BeamDetector seeded pickup at position 0 -> mirrored grouping ([3]+[flag] vs LP [flag]+[3]). MeasureStartPosition = period - pickup length (\partial = PartialSet, measurePosition -dur). fixture test/autobeam-pickup

autobeam-nobeam.ly.notes: no noBeam in Lily# grammar (only manual [ ] groups)

autobeam-tuplet-recheck.ly.claim: autobeam rechecking works with tuplets: first beat beams together
autobeam-tuplet-recheck.ly.notes: grouping [16 16 t8 t16][t8 t16 16 16] matches LP. Residual: LP prints tuplet BRACKETS here, Lily# bare numbers — known un-ported tuplet-bracket family (HANDOFF lp_calc: tuplet on-line/bracket)

beam-auto.ly.claim: autobeam presets for common time signatures
beam-auto.ly.notes: 14 meters x 8th/16th/32nd: beam-segment fingerprint 202==202 vs LP and page-by-page visual match (incl the odd-but-correct 4/16 row: unbeamed 8ths+16ths, 32nds in pairs). Validates BeamingPattern presets wholesale

beam-forced-direction.ly.notes: no _[/^[ sigils in Lily# (stem forcing @stemUp/@stemDown is the Lily# spelling; covered by own fixtures)
